newsitem.title: USA: Xoma, Pfizer to stop E5 trial.
newsitem.headline: Xoma, Pfizer to stop E5 trial.

text.p: Xoma Corp said it and Pfizer Inc have decided to discontinue the U.S. clinical trial of the E5 monoclonal antibody as a treatment for gram-negative sepsis because an interim analysis did not support continuation of the trials.

"Althought there were no safety concerns, and a benefit was shown for patients trated with E5, the results were not sufficient to meet the predetermined efficacy criteria deemed necessary to continue the trial," Xoma said in the statement.
Xoma said it does not expect a significant financial impact from discontinuing the trial.
